withheld.jp: たカケラが……巨大な母体にまざって、戯れる。
withheld.en: The plating of a pretension that reminds of the nihility of cynicism dissolves, and the fragments that become bare... gather around the bodies of giant mothers and frolic.
comments: The plating of pretension etc. is Taichi's big worded language and pseudo-Third Reich stuff, so that's simply about shedding the obvious superficial reading. The rest sounds odd, but we have two huge mothers here already if you'll notice; one is Yusa's, and besides looks she was defined giant most explicitly, the other is Nanaka - back when he was a child, she was necessarily gigantic.
Reciprocal sexual harassment is well seen in most Nanaka encounters; having a different kind of fun with Yusa's mother, seen again in this route, also matches. Leaving it literal. -GHS
